title: Evidence record — v1.0
description: plan.md §11, chainlink #20. One per evidence/<id>.json -- workspace-level, not crate-scoped (evidence isn't owned by any one crate, unlike boundary/interaction/exemption/protocol-debt artifacts). The claim field is required: a hash and location identify bytes, not the proposition the analysis relies on. semantic_disposition is split from lifecycle so aspirational doesn't act as both authority and lifecycle state, and Mode R gets the rejected/deferred/out-of-scope states it needs. Deliberately has NO review block: plan.md §7.2's human-checkpoint list names 'evidence-conflict resolution', not evidence itself -- Stage 0 evidence intake is LLM-proposed and non-normative (plan.md's own flow diagram: 'LLM SIDE -- proposes, NON-NORMATIVE'). Consequently this artifact type is never routed through pipeline.py's approve() (which unconditionally injects a review block that this schema's additionalProperties:false would reject) -- see scripts/validate_evidence.py's module docstring.

schema_version.description: Not shown in plan.md §11's own (terser) worked example, but added for consistency with every other schema in this codebase, all of which carry one.

id.description: Must equal the filename stem exactly (G1b, enforced by scripts/validate_evidence.py).

claim.description: The proposition this evidence supports -- required, per plan.md §11: 'a hash and location identify bytes, not the proposition the analysis relies on.'

line_hint.description: A single line ('118') or an inclusive range ('118-160'), matching the worked example.
